_comment: Complete ServerChecks.json reference. These examples are not run.
Name and Host are required. Port, User, Info, Services, and Processes are optional.
A single item may be written as one value. Multiple items use a JSON list in square brackets.

ServerChecks._comment: Minimal check: DNS, ping, and the DefaultTcpPort from Settings.json.
ServerChecks.Name: Minimal server check

_comment: Single-value form for Port, Info, Services, and Processes.
User is omitted, so requested remote checks use the operator's current Windows account.
ServerChecks.Name: Single-value server check

ServerChecks._comment: Multiple-value form with an explicit account. Its password is requested once per run and kept only in memory.
ServerChecks._comment_Info: Info accepts uptime, os, memory, cpu, disk, or all.
ServerChecks.Name: Full server check

ServerChecks._comment: The all shortcut requests uptime, OS, memory, CPU, and disk information.
ServerChecks.Name: All server information

ServerChecks._comment: Use localhost or a single period to check the computer running Server Postflight without a credential prompt.
ServerChecks.Name: Local computer
